hints.secretKey: From Developers → API keys in the Stripe Dashboard. A key starting with sk_test_ takes test payments, sk_live_ takes real ones.
hints.publishableKey: Shown next to the secret key in the Stripe Dashboard. The storefront loads the Stripe payment form with it. Use a key of the same mode as the secret key.
hints.webhookSecret: Verifies Stripe webhook notifications. Shown on the webhook endpoint that sends payment_intent.succeeded and payment_intent.amount_capturable_updated to /hooks/payment/stripe_<id> on your backend.
hints.capture: With Capture right away, the payment is one-stage and the money is debited right away. With Authorize only, it is two-stage and the amount is held until you capture it. If the amount is not captured within 7 days, Stripe releases the hold on the card.
hints.paymentMethodConfiguration: The ID of a payment method configuration from Settings → Payment methods in the Stripe Dashboard. Without it, your account's default configuration decides which payment methods the customer sees.
hints.paymentDescription: Shown on the payment in the Stripe Dashboard.
hints.statementDescriptorSuffix: Added after the prefix from your Stripe account settings on the customer's card statement. Latin letters only, and 22 characters at most together with the prefix.
hints.sendReceiptEmail: In live mode, Stripe emails a receipt to the email the customer gave at checkout.
